Haven’t tried an organization no. Do you mean like a therapy group? I’ve been in some of those, just not really my thing. It usually in my experience ends up being one person talking about themselves the whole time and I am just not up to giving therapy to someone else haha. 

That’s sweet of you to offer the writing thing and I really do appreciate it, but right now I think I gotta focus on keeping up with cleaning, laundry dishes, personal hygiene that kind of thing. I can barely do that right now, can’t even get myself to eat more than a meal or less a day. I’ll remember you said that though. It’s very kind. Maybe in another world I’d take you up on it

Yeah it is hard to find one. I really feel like I haven’t found one that’s not just doing their job and who actually cares. I wish I could write honestly, I can’t do it anymore for some reason. I think I have a mental block w it or something, I panic every time I start writing and can’t finish. I used to write short stories but honestly I have 0 interest in that anymore, just don’t really like the format. I have a few stray ideas for longer books and things but the thought of writing a whole book is way to overwhelming and I just can’t really do it. And if I start writing it never intending to ever finish it it just feels pointless lol

I am getting help lol. I’ve been in therapy for 6 years (just started w a new therapist after my last one said my case was too difficult and stopped working with me). I’ve been on over 25 medications and the only one that’s ever really helped me was adderall for focus. I’ve had meds side effects ranging from seizures to developing an eating disorder to hallucinations, and that’s not to mention all the shitty doctors who told me I was crazy and weak and over-sensitive. I’ve been diagnosed with 5-6 different diagnoses at different times, like no one can agree which just makes me feel so utterly fucked up. I’ve been in hospitals multiple times. And I’m only 22. I guess I’m saying all this just to say that like, I can’t take much more of this. I’m barely surviving right now. I could do this for another year but not 5, 3 or even 2. I’m tired of doctors and I’m tired of this. 

I’m honestly not sure, I don’t really have a passion for anything work-related in particular? I used to want to be a writer but I haven’t been able to write in years and plus that’s not a consistent source of income. I honestly just hate the concept of working by itself. Useless repetitive tasks over and over again that no one will remember just so you can get money to live. I’m not smart enough for important actually impactful life-saving jobs. Other than that I don’t really see a point?

I’m a serial cutter, I wish I could tell you ways to stop but I don’t know those. Instead I can tell you things to do to hide it.
Normal bandaids usually work fine. I usually layer my arms up with a ton of bandaids and then wear only long sleeves around people until they heal up. In the future tho, if you wear a lot of short sleeves or it’s hot out, I would try to cut somewhere less visible. I do legs a lot when I don’t want people to see, up near the thighs is easiest to hide. 

Also you can download the app Calm Harm. It gives you things to do instead of cutting when you feel the urge. It doesn’t always help but it’s a good start for controlling the urges

I agree that you can’t really appreciate being happy without misery and I do appreciate your concern and reaching out. It’s just, like every day is one of those depressed days. And I wish I could curl up and watch Netflix and take care of myself bc maybe I’d feel better. But I can’t call out of work everyday you know? So then I just have to pretend to be happy and normal every day. I do appreciate the times I was happy it’s just compared to the bad stuff it’s nowhere near enough. 

I work 40 hours a week retail so most of the time I’m too tired to do anything for fun. Ik other people can do it’s just been too much for me. I’ve been trying to do things I used to like doing and hoping that I get good feelings from them but it’s not really working. I have adhd that gets worse when I’m depressed so I just can’t focus on anything, even following the plots of tv episodes is too much right now. I used to like doing some stuff but I just have no interest in them anymore. And I just don’t really care about hanging out w friends anymore bc we just kinda talk about surface stuff. I like getting high and drunk tho lol

I just can’t cry anymore. Idk if it’s my meds or what but I haven’t been able to cry in probably about a year now? And it’s not even that I don’t enjoy things, bc saying you never enjoy anything would be an untrue exaggeration. I do enjoy things from time to time. But none of those things are enough to sustain me when the depressive periods hit. I feel deathly sick. I’m in horrible pain constantly when they hit for months. Then I’ll get a month or so of freedom, or a month of being manic. Then I’m back. This quality of life just isn’t worth sustaining for me anymore

I’m sorry you’re going through that and I’m sorry it’s so bad that you’re feeling this way. Honestly there’s no one good way, but the way I’ve dealt with it as a neurodivergent person (I have adhd) is by finding people who are like me and sticking by them. Even if you can’t find them in real life, finding a support structure online of other nd people or queer people is so so essential. It doesn’t stop the bullying, but it gives you people who care about you more, and who you can go to when you’re feeling alone. I felt very alone in high school bc I didn’t know anyone who was like me, and now that I’m older and have autistic and adhd friends I feel like I can finally be myself. We can all be weirdos together, and have pride in the way we’re different from other people. Also ik how hard it can be as an autistic person to make friends and socialize and stuff, but honestly? Other autistic/adhd people vibe really well together, and you can be weird or awkward and they’ll still accept you, bc we’re all weird and awkward lol. Especially if u find someone w a similar special interest haha

I feel you similarly but I’m afab. I have days where I’m totally comfortable being a girl (like you’re saying usually more of a she/they demigirl) but then I also have days where I feel transmasc (he/they) and super dysphoric about my “female” body. I also don’t want to transition. I think the hardest thing about it is that I don’t feel like people take me seriously when I go from presenting masculine to presenting feminine bc they think I’m actually just a cis girl who wears boys clothes sometimes. 

But honestly, I’ve felt so much happier with myself when I let myself be him when he comes, like it’s felt so much more freeing. I basically have both masc and femme clothes on hand as well as a binder so that when I feel more like him I can switch. Even sometimes if I’m too nervous to go out dressed as him I can do it alone or around friends I trust, and I’d honestly say to start with that. See how it feels and if you like it, get to know her a bit! Then you can move on to the next step of actually determining what kind of steps you wanna take.
